title: Starbucks books unspent-card revenue equal to ~8% of operating income

hook.a: Starbucks' unspent-card revenue now equals about eight percent of its operating income.
hook.b: Starbucks profits when its cards go unspent.

numbers.label: Total net revenues FY2025
numbers.formula: 0.6% = $222.4M / $37,184.4M. Breakage / operating income: $222.4M / $2,936.6M = ~7.6% (FY2025; operating margin 7.9% x $37,184.4M, from the 10-K); $207.6M / ~$5.4B = ~3.8% (FY2024), using the 10-K's rounded operating income. Per store: $222.4M / 40,990 = ~$5,400.

analysis.title: How big is Starbucks' breakage, really?
analysis.finding: Breakage was $222M in FY2025: only 0.6% of revenue but ~7.6% of operating income, up from ~3.8% a year earlier because operating income fell from ~$5.4B to ~$2.9B. It works out to ~$5.4K per store.

scenes.vo: now equals about eight percent of its operating income.
